title: A Full-Ledger Counterfactual Audit of Adaptive Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22778v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adaptive reasoning must decide whether to answer now or spend more compute. Predicting that the current answer is wrong does not establish whether further reasoning will improve it. We introduce the Full-Ledger Counterfactual Value Audit (FLCVA), which compares an immediate answer with four fixed-length continuations from the same frozen prefix under one answer procedure and accounts for the cost of every signal used by a policy. On GSM8K and MATH-500, a random 256-token continuation recovers a wrong answer in 26.6% of Qwen3-8B cases and 18.9% of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B cases, while damaging a correct answer in 1.4% and 1.9%. Correctness labels from independently sampled continuations predict a separate continuation's outcome in both primary models. In offline replay, using these labels to allocate compute improves performance on DeepSeek; the Qwen3 gain remains inconclusive. Under full cost accounting, the tested lightweight, myopic

translated_title: 自适应推理的全账本反事实审计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.22778v1 公告类型：new。自适应推理必须决定是立即给出答案，还是花费更多算力继续推理。然而，预测当前答案是错误的，并不能证明进一步的推理就能将其改善。我们提出了全账本反事实价值审计（FLCVA），它在统一的回答流程下，将立即给出的答案与来自同一冻结前缀的四个固定长度续写进行对比，并对策略所使用的每一个信号的成本进行核算。在GSM8K和MATH-500上，随机的256-token续写在Qwen3-8B的26.6%案例和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B的18.9%案例中修复了原本错误的答案，而在1.4%和1.9%的案例中损害了原本正确的答案。来自独立采样续写的正确性标签在两个主要模型中均能预测另一续写的结果。在离线回放中，利用这些标签来分配算力提升了DeepSeek的性能，而Qwen3上的增益尚无定论。在完整成本核算下，所测试的轻量级、短视的（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出FLCVA审计框架，通过在同一冻结前缀上对比立即回答与固定长度续写的反事实结果并进行全成本核算，发现随机续写能以极低损害率（约1-2%）修复大量错误答案（约19-27%），且续写正确性标签可用于指导算力分配。
en_tdlr: FLCVA audits whether extended reasoning actually improves answers by comparing immediate responses with fixed-length counterfactual continuations under full cost accounting, revealing that random continuations fix 19-27% of wrong answers with only 1-2% damage, and continuation correctness labels can guide compute allocation.
